author: SillySquirrel
body:
Hey, DruMC here (previously DinNewman) and I was banned on August 30, 2013. Back then the server wasn't very popular and had little staff to moderate the pvp games.There was this one map where the Ore blocks were placed from the ground level to the bottom of the map (It wasn't very thick), and there wasnt much of it. Countless times, I've been spleefed on that specific map, but nobody ever cared, or reported, nothing was done about it. That was until the one time a mod or helper joined the game and participated in the action. Being that I wanted to be one of the people who got diamond armor, I tryed as hard as I could to get those blocks, and without even knowing it, one of the people on top fell down because I mined the block, unintentionally spleefing them. I was then banned by red_dark95 (They may have changed their name) for "5d team grief" and until recently I never knew the server grew so much that my friends started to play. And this ban has really got in the way of doing that obviously. I think almost 2 years of having no access to one of my first favorite servers is a long enough wait. I can't say I've learned from it because the spleefing was unintentional but if those kinds of maps do still exist, I promise I will be more careful as to where I mine. 

- Dru

replies.body:
Hello,

Seeing that you have been banned for a very long time i have decided to appeal your ban.

Please read the rules before you rejoin the server.
